latest_release.name: v2.7.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed

### Features

* Feature: use `pflag` as drop-in replacement by @xjasonlyu in https://github.com/xjasonlyu/tun2socks/pull/513
* Feature(proxy): support ssh proxy protocol by @xjasonlyu in https://github.com/xjasonlyu/tun2socks/pull/519
* Feature: support custom ICMP message handling by @nange in https://github.com/xjasonlyu/tun2socks/pull/521

### Fixes

* Fix: update gVisor dependency and modify UDP handler to return a boolean by @SuzukiHonoka in https://github.com/xjasonlyu/tun2socks/pull/487
* Fix: crash on multiple start/stop due to FD being closed twice by @vecljox in https://github.com/xjasonlyu/tun2socks/pull/495
* Fix(log): set log level for `glog` by @xjasonlyu in https://github.com/xjasonlyu/tun2socks/pull/511
* Fix(stack): respond to ICMPv4 echo messages by @xjasonlyu in https://github.com/xjasonlyu/tun2socks/pull/514
* Fix: icmp interface binding by @nange in https://github.com/xjasonlyu/tun2socks/pull/524
* Fix(build): remove unsupported windows/arm32 target by @xjasonlyu with @Copilot in https://github.com/xjasonlyu/tun2socks/pull/542

### Others

* Refactor(proxy): registrable proxy protocol by @xjasonlyu in https://github.com/xjasonlyu/tun2socks/pull/517
* Refactor(engine): parse multicast groups by @xjasonlyu in https://github.com/xjasonlyu/tun2socks/pull/518
* Refactor(dialer): with socket options by @xjasonlyu in https://github.com/xjasonlyu/tun2socks/pull/525
* Refactor: ID should return a copy for TCP/UDPConn by @xjasonlyu in https://github.com/xjasonlyu/tun2socks/pull/522
* CI: add tun2socks e2e tests by @xjasonlyu in https://github.com/xjasonlyu/tun2socks/pull/510
* CI(test): update test workflow by @xjasonlyu in https://github.com/xjasonlyu/tun2socks/pull/516
* Chore: bump to go1.26 by @xjasonlyu in https://github.com/xjasonlyu/tun2socks/pull/526

## New Contributors
* @vecljox made their first contribution in https://github.com/xjasonlyu/tun2socks/pull/495
* @xjasonlyu with @Copilot made their first contribution in https://github.com/xjasonlyu/tun2socks/pull/542

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/xjasonlyu/tun2socks/compare/v2.6.0...v2.7.0
